p1out=[[6,6,6,6],[6,3,9,6],[6,3,6,6],[6,6,6,6]]
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    base=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==base]
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r,c in pts:
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while st:
            a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
            for da,db in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                q=(a+da,b+db)
                if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]] in (base,):
                    seen.add(q);st.append(q)
        objs.append(comp)
    # Components are split by holes; instead scan same-size non-bg rectangular clusters using row intervals grouping.
    # Derive rectangles from connected components allowing anomalies as part of component.
    fg={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg}
    seen=set(); rects=[]
    for p in sorted(fg):
        if p in seen:continue
        st=[p];seen.add(p);comp=[]
        while st:
            a,b=st.pop();comp.append((a,b))
            for q in [(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]:
                if q in fg and q not in seen:seen.add(q);st.append(q)
        rs=[x[0] for x in comp];cs=[x[1] for x in comp]
        rects.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    H=max(b-a+1 for a,b,c,d in rects);W=max(d-c+1 for a,b,c,d in rects)
    out=[[base]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for a,b,c,d in rects:
        for r in range(a,b+1):
            for col in range(c,d+1):
                if grid[r][col]!=base:out[r-a][col-c]=grid[r][col]
    return out
